name: MAX_JOBS
description: max compile thread number for package building. Usually, it is set to; the number of CPU cores. If not set, the default value is None, which; means all number of CPU cores will be used.

name: CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE
description: The build type of the package. It can be one of the following values:; Release, Debug, RelWithDebugInfo. If not set, the default value is Release.

name: COMPILE_CUSTOM_KERNELS
description: Whether to compile custom kernels. If not set, the default value is True.; If set to False, the custom kernels will not be compiled.; This configuration option should only be set to False when running UT; scenarios in an environment without an NPU. Do not set it to False in; other scenarios.

name: CXX_COMPILER
description: The CXX compiler used for compiling the package. If not set, the default; value is None, which means the system default CXX compiler will be used.

name: C_COMPILER
description: The C compiler used for compiling the package. If not set, the default; value is None, which means the system default C compiler will be used.

name: SOC_VERSION
description: The version of the Ascend chip. It's used for package building.; If not set, we will query chip info through `npu-smi`.; Please make sure that the version is correct.

name: VERBOSE

name: ASCEND_HOME_PATH
description: The home path for CANN toolkit. If not set, the default value is; /usr/local/Ascend/ascend-toolkit/latest

name: HCCL_SO_PATH
description: The path for HCCL library, it's used by pyhccl communicator backend. If; not set, the default value is libhccl.so.

name: VLLM_VERSION
description: The version of vllm is installed. This value is used for developers who; installed vllm from source locally. In this case, the version of vllm is; usually changed. For example, if the version of vllm is "0.9.0", but when; it's installed from source, the version of vllm is usually set to "0.9.1".

name: DYNAMIC_EPLB

name: VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_BATCH_MEMCPY
description: Control the aclrtMemcpyBatchAsync compile path for KV cache offloading.; "1": force enable, "0": force disable, None: auto-detect from CANN headers.

name: VLLM_ASCEND_KVPOOL_RANGE_DEBUG
description: Emit per-layer KVPool ranged transfer audit events. Default: 0 (disabled).; Valid values: 0 or 1. This configuration is not sensitive.

name: VLLM_ASCEND_ROPE_UB_SIZE_KB
description: Override the Unified Buffer (UB) size in KB for Triton kernel tile sizing.; 0 (default): auto-detect from device properties, falling back to 192 KB; (safe for Ascend 910B/A3). Set to a positive value to override when; auto-detection is unavailable or for debugging UB overflow issues.

name: --model
description: Name or path of the Hugging Face model to use. It is also used as the content for `model_name` tag in metrics output when `served_model_name` is not specified.

name: --runner
description: The type of model runner to use. Each vLLM instance only supports one model runner, even if the same model can be used for multiple types.

name: --convert
description: Convert the model using adapters defined in [vllm.model_executor.models.adapters][]. The most common use case is to adapt a text generation model to be used for pooling tasks.

name: --tokenizer
description: Name or path of the Hugging Face tokenizer to use. If unspecified, model name or path will be used.

name: --tokenizer-mode
description: Tokenizer mode: - "auto" will use the tokenizer from `mistral_common` for Mistral models if available, otherwise it will use the "hf" tokenizer. - "hf" will use the fast tokenizer if available. - "slow" will always use the slow tokenizer.

name: --trust-remote-code
description: Trust remote code (e.g., from HuggingFace) when downloading the model and tokenizer.

name: --dtype
description: Data type for model weights and activations: - "auto" will use FP16 precision for FP32 and FP16 models, and BF16 precision for BF16 models. - "half" for FP16. Recommended for AWQ quantization. - "float16" is the same as "half". - "bfloat16" for a balance between precision and range.

name: --seed
description: Random seed for reproducibility. We must set the global seed because otherwise, different tensor parallel workers would sample different tokens, leading to inconsistent results.

name: --hf-config-path
description: Name or path of the Hugging Face config to use. If unspecified, model name or path will be used.

name: --allowed-local-media-path
description: Allowing API requests to read local images or videos from directories specified by the server file system. This is a security risk. Should only be enabled in trusted environments.

name: --allowed-media-domains
description: If set, only media URLs that belong to this domain can be used for multi-modal inputs.

name: --revision
description: The specific model version to use. It can be a branch name, a tag name, or a commit id. If unspecified, will use the default version.

name: --code-revision
description: The specific revision to use for the model code on the Hugging Face Hub. It can be a branch name, a tag name, or a commit id. If unspecified, will use the default version.

name: --tokenizer-revision
description: The specific revision to use for the tokenizer on the Hugging Face Hub. It can be a branch name, a tag name, or a commit id. If unspecified, will use the default version.

name: --max-model-len
description: Model context length (prompt and output). If unspecified, will be automatically derived from the model config. When passing via `--max-model-len`, supports k/m/g/K/M/G in human-readable format. Examples: - 1k -> 1000 - 1K -> 1024 - 25.

name: --quantization
description: Method used to quantize the weights. If `None`, we first check the `quantization_config` attribute in the model config file. If that is `None`, we assume the model weights are not quantized and use `dtype` to determine the data type of the weights.

name: --quantization-config
description: User-facing quantization configuration. Carries per-layer-kind specs (linear, moe) and ignore patterns; see :class:`QuantizationConfigArgs`. Auto-populated from the matching online shorthand when `quantization` is one of the values in `ONLINE_QUANT_SHORTHAND_NAMES`.

name: --allow-deprecated-quantization
description: Whether to allow deprecated quantization methods.

name: --enforce-eager
description: Whether to always use eager-mode PyTorch. If True, we will disable CUDA graph and always execute the model in eager mode. If False, we will use CUDA graph and eager execution in hybrid for maximal performance and flexibility. NOTE: This disables both `torch.

name: --enable-return-routed-experts
description: Whether to return routed experts.

name: --return-sampling-mask
description: Whether to return the post-processing token support for each sample.

name: --max-logprobs
description: Maximum number of log probabilities to return when `logprobs` is specified in `SamplingParams`. The default value comes the default for the OpenAI Chat Completions API. -1 means no cap, i.e. all (output_length * vocab_size) logprobs are allowed to be returned and it may cause OOM.

name: --logprobs-mode
description: Indicates the content returned in the logprobs and prompt_logprobs. Supported mode: 1) raw_logprobs, 2) processed_logprobs, 3) raw_logits, 4) processed_logits. Raw means the values before applying any logit processors, like bad words.

name: --use-fp64-gumbel
description: Whether to use FP64 (instead of FP32) random noise for Gumbel-max and equivalent exponential-race sampling. FP64 preserves lower-tail sampling events that fp32 uniform/exponential draws can truncate, at the cost of significantly lower throughput on most GPUs.

name: --enable-trace-replay
description: Whether to allow requests to set `SamplingParams.trace_decode_token_ids`, which forces decoding to follow a predetermined token sequence while still computing real logprobs. Reserved for debugging and RL workflows: enabling it reserves a per-request trace buffer, so it is off by default.

name: --disable-sliding-window
description: Whether to disable sliding window. If True, we will disable the sliding window functionality of the model, capping to sliding window size. If the model does not support sliding window, this argument is ignored.

name: --disable-cascade-attn
description: Disable cascade attention for V1. While cascade attention does not change the mathematical correctness, disabling it could be useful for preventing potential numerical issues. This defaults to True, so users must opt in to cascade attention by setting this to False.

name: --skip-tokenizer-init
description: Skip initialization of tokenizer and detokenizer. Expects valid `prompt_token_ids` and `None` for prompt from the input. The generated output will contain token ids.

name: --enable-prompt-embeds
description: If `True`, enables passing text embeddings as inputs via the `prompt_embeds` key. WARNING: The vLLM engine may crash if incorrect shape of embeddings is passed. Only enable this flag for trusted users!

name: --served-model-name
description: The model name(s) used in the API. If multiple names are provided, the server will respond to any of the provided names. The model name in the model field of a response will be the first name in this list. If not specified, the model name will be the same as the `--model` argument.

name: --config-format
description: The format of the model config to load: - "auto" will try to load the config in hf format if available after trying to load in mistral format. - "hf" will load the config in hf format. - "mistral" will load the config in mistral format.

name: --hf-token
description: The token to use as HTTP bearer authorization for remote files . If `True`, will use the token generated when running `hf auth login` (stored in `~/.cache/huggingface/token`).

name: --hf-overrides
description: If a dictionary, contains arguments to be forwarded to the Hugging Face config. If a callable, it is called to update the HuggingFace config.

name: --model-class-overrides
description: Override the model class used for one or more architectures, mapping the architecture name to a `"module:class"` target (the same format accepted by `ModelRegistry.register_model`). This registers the target class at runtime, e.g. `{"GlmMoeDsaForCausalLM": "vllm.models.deepseek_v32.nvidia.

name: --pooler-config
description: Pooler config which controls the behaviour of output pooling in pooling models.

name: --generation-config
description: The folder path to the generation config. Defaults to `"auto"`, the generation config will be loaded from model path. If set to `"vllm"`, no generation config is loaded, vLLM defaults will be used. If set to a folder path, the generation config will be loaded from the specified folder path.

name: --override-generation-config
description: Overrides or sets generation config. e.g. `{"temperature": 0.5}`. If used with `--generation-config auto`, the override parameters will be merged with the default config from the model. If used with `--generation-config vllm`, only the override parameters are used.

name: --enable-sleep-mode
description: Enable sleep mode for the engine (only cuda and hip platforms are supported).

name: --enable-cumem-allocator
description: Enable the custom cumem allocator to leverage advanced GPU memory allocation features such as multi-node NVLink support. Sleep mode automatically enables this allocator. Only cuda and hip platforms are supported.

name: --enable-nccl-comm-suspend
description: Enable releasing NCCL communicator memory during sleep mode (``ncclCommSuspend``/``ncclCommResume``). Experimental; when disabled (the default) sleep still releases weights/KV-cache memory as before.

name: --model-impl
description: Which implementation of the model to use: - "auto" will try to use the vLLM implementation, if it exists, and fall back to the Transformers implementation if no vLLM implementation is available. - "vllm" will use the vLLM model implementation.

name: --logits-processors
description: One or more logits processors' fully-qualified class names or class definitions

name: --io-processor-plugin
description: IOProcessor plugin name to load at model startup

name: --renderer-num-workers
description: Number of worker threads in the renderer thread pool. The pool is consumed by the async renderer path (e.g. the OpenAI-compatible API server started by `vllm serve`) to parallelize tokenization, chat template rendering, and multimodal preprocessing across concurrent requests.

name: --load-format
description: The format of the model weights to load. - "auto" will try to load the weights in the safetensors format and fall back to the pytorch bin format if safetensors format is not available. - "pt" will load the weights in the pytorch bin format.

name: --download-dir
description: Directory to download and load the weights, default to the default cache directory of Hugging Face.

name: --safetensors-load-strategy
description: Specifies the loading strategy for safetensors weights. - None (default): Uses memory-mapped (lazy) loading. When an NFS filesystem is detected and the total checkpoint size fits within 90%% of available RAM, prefetching is enabled automatically. - "lazy": Weights are memory-mapped from the file.

name: --safetensors-prefetch-num-threads
description: Number of worker threads used to prefetch safetensors checkpoint files into the OS page cache when safetensors prefetching is enabled.

name: --safetensors-prefetch-block-size
description: Read size in bytes for each safetensors checkpoint file prefetch.

name: --model-loader-extra-config
description: Extra config for model loader. This will be passed to the model loader corresponding to the chosen load_format.

name: --ignore-patterns
description: The list of patterns to ignore when loading the model. Default to "original/**/*" to avoid repeated loading of llama's checkpoints.

name: --use-tqdm-on-load
description: Whether to enable tqdm for showing progress bar when loading model weights.

name: --pt-load-map-location
description: The map location for loading pytorch checkpoint, to support loading checkpoints can only be loaded on certain devices like "cuda", this is equivalent to `{"": "cuda"}`. Another supported format is mapping from different devices like from GPU 1 to GPU 0: `{"cuda:1": "cuda:0"}`.

name: --attention-backend
description: Attention backend to use. Use "auto" or None for automatic selection.

name: --mamba-backend
description: Mamba SSU backend to use.

name: --mamba-ssu-algorithm
description: Selective state update algorithm to use with the FlashInfer backend. None defaults to FlashInfer's "auto" algorithm. Forced algorithms must be supported by FlashInfer for the active GPU, state dtype, and decoding mode.

name: --enable-mamba-cache-stochastic-rounding
description: Enable stochastic rounding when writing SSM state to fp16 cache. Uses random bits to unbias the rounding error, which can improve numerical stability for long sequences.

name: --mamba-cache-philox-rounds
description: Number of Philox PRNG rounds for stochastic rounding random number generation. 0 uses the Triton default. Higher values improve randomness quality at the cost of compute.

name: --reasoning-parser-plugin
description: Path to a dynamically reasoning parser plugin that can be dynamically loaded and registered.

name: --distributed-executor-backend
description: Backend to use for distributed model workers, either "ray" or "mp" (multiprocessing). If the product of pipeline_parallel_size and tensor_parallel_size is less than or equal to the number of GPUs available, "mp" will be used to keep processing on a single host. Otherwise, an error will be raised.

name: --pipeline-parallel-size
description: Number of pipeline parallel groups.

name: --master-addr
description: distributed master address for multi-node distributed inference when distributed_executor_backend is mp.

name: --master-port
description: distributed master port for multi-node distributed inference when distributed_executor_backend is mp.

name: --nnodes
description: num of nodes for multi-node distributed inference when distributed_executor_backend is mp.

name: --node-rank
description: distributed node rank for multi-node distributed inference when distributed_executor_backend is mp.

name: --distributed-timeout-seconds
description: Timeout in seconds for distributed operations (e.g., init_process_group). If set, this value is passed to torch.distributed.init_process_group as the timeout parameter. If None, PyTorch's default timeout is used (600s for NCCL). Increase this for multi-node setups where model downloads may be slow.

name: --cpu-distributed-timeout-seconds
description: Timeout (in seconds) for cpu communication groups. If None, PyTorch's default timeout is used (1800s for gloo).

name: --numa-bind
description: Enable NUMA binding for GPU worker subprocesses. By default, workers are pinned to their GPU's NUMA-local CPUs and memory; on PCT-capable Xeons they also auto-bind to the SKU's PCT priority cores.

name: --numa-bind-nodes
description: NUMA node to bind each GPU worker to. Specify one NUMA node per visible GPU, for example `[0, 0, 1, 1]` for a 4-GPU system with GPUs 0-1 on NUMA node 0 and GPUs 2-3 on NUMA node 1. If unset and `numa_bind=True`, vLLM auto-detects the GPU-to-NUMA topology.

name: --numa-bind-cpus
description: Optional CPU lists to bind each GPU worker to. Specify one CPU list per visible GPU, for example `["0-3", "4-7", "8-11", "12-15"]`. When set, vLLM uses `numactl --physcpubind` instead of `--cpunodebind`. This is useful for custom policies such as binding to PCT or other high-frequency cores.

name: --tensor-parallel-size
description: Number of tensor parallel groups.

name: --decode-context-parallel-size
description: Number of ranks that shard the decode KV cache. DCP does not expand the process world size. Without PCP, DCP reuses TP ranks. With PCP, DCP either spans the PCP axis or the full TP x PCP block.

name: --dcp-comm-backend
description: Communication backend for Decode Context Parallel (DCP). - "ag_rs": AllGather + ReduceScatter (existing behavior) - "a2a": All-to-All exchange of partial outputs + LSE, then combine with Triton kernel. Reduces NCCL calls from 3 to 2 per layer for MLA models.

name: --dcp-q-replicate
description: Replicate the MLA query projection within each DCP group so decode can skip the query all-gather. With DCP the KV cache is sharded across the group, so the standard MLA decode path all-gathers the query every step.

name: --dcp-kv-cache-interleave-size
description: Interleave size of kv_cache storage while using DCP. dcp_kv_cache_interleave_size has been replaced by cp_kv_cache_interleave_size, and will be deprecated when PCP is fully supported.

name: --prefill-context-parallel-size
description: Number of ranks that split prefill sequence computation. PCP expands the process world size but does not increase the KV-cache shard count.

name: --data-parallel-size
description: Number of data parallel groups. MoE layers will be sharded according to the product of the tensor, prefill-context, and data parallel sizes.

name: --data-parallel-rank
description: Data parallel rank of this instance.

name: --data-parallel-start-rank
description: Starting data parallel rank for secondary nodes.

name: --data-parallel-size-local
description: Number of data parallel replicas to run on this node.

name: --data-parallel-address
description: Address of data parallel cluster head-node.

name: --data-parallel-rpc-port
description: Fixed port for data parallel RPC communication. All nodes

name: --data-parallel-hybrid-lb
description: Whether to use "hybrid" DP LB mode. Applies only to online serving and when data_parallel_size > 0. Enables running an AsyncLLM and API server on a "per-node" basis where vLLM load balances between local data parallel ranks, but an external LB balances between vLLM nodes/replicas.

name: --data-parallel-external-lb
description: Whether to use "external" DP LB mode. Applies only to online serving and when data_parallel_size > 0. This is useful for a "one-pod-per-rank" wide-EP setup in Kubernetes. Supported only for MoE deployments; non-MoE models should use independent vLLM instances without --data-parallel-* arguments.

name: --data-parallel-multi-port-external-lb
description: Run a node-local supervisor that launches one external-LB API

name: --enable-expert-parallel
description: Use expert parallelism instead of tensor parallelism for MoE layers.

name: --enable-batch-sharded-sampling
description: Use sharded sampling across tensor parallel ranks. Each rank samples a slice of the batch instead of every rank sampling all of it. Currently defaults to False if not set.

name: --enable-ep-weight-filter
description: Skip non-local expert weights during model loading when expert parallelism is active. Each rank only reads its own expert shard from disk, which can drastically reduce storage I/O for MoE models with per-expert weight tensors (e.g. DeepSeek, Mixtral, Kimi-K2.5).

name: --all2all-backend
description: All2All backend for MoE expert parallel communication.

name: --enable-dbo
description: Enable dual batch overlap for the model executor.

name: --ubatch-size
description: Number of ubatch size.

name: --enable-elastic-ep
description: Enable elastic expert parallelism with stateless NCCL groups for DP/EP.

name: --elastic-ep-max-dp-size
description: Maximum data parallel size supported by elastic expert parallelism.

name: --dbo-decode-token-threshold
description: The threshold for dual batch overlap for batches only containing decodes. If the number of tokens in the request is greater than this threshold, microbatching will be used. Otherwise, the request will be processed in a single batch.

name: --dp-sync-interval
description: Steps between DP finish-sync all-reduces; must match across DP ranks.

name: --dbo-prefill-token-threshold
description: The threshold for dual batch overlap for batches that contain one or more prefills. If the number of tokens in the request is greater than this threshold, microbatching will be used. Otherwise, the request will be processed in a single batch.

name: --disable-nccl-for-dp-synchronization
description: Forces the dp synchronization logic in vllm/v1/worker/dp_utils.py to use Gloo instead of NCCL for its all reduce. Defaults to True when async scheduling is enabled, False otherwise.

name: --enable-eplb
description: Enable expert parallelism load balancing for MoE layers.

name: --eplb-config
description: Expert parallelism configuration.

name: --expert-placement-strategy
description: The expert placement strategy for MoE layers: - "linear": Experts are placed in a contiguous manner. For example, with 4 experts and 2 ranks, rank 0 will have experts [0, 1] and rank 1 will have experts [2, 3]. - "round_robin": Experts are placed in a round-robin manner.

name: --max-parallel-loading-workers
description: Maximum number of parallel loading workers when loading model sequentially in multiple batches. To avoid RAM OOM when using tensor parallel and large models.

name: --ray-workers-use-nsight
description: Whether to profile Ray workers with nsight, see https://docs.ray.io/en/latest/ray-observability/user-guides/profiling.html#profiling-nsight-profiler.

name: --disable-custom-all-reduce
description: Disable the custom all-reduce kernel and fall back to NCCL.

name: --worker-cls
description: The full name of the worker class to use. If "auto", the worker class will be determined based on the platform.

name: --worker-extension-cls
description: The full name of the worker extension class to use. The worker extension class is dynamically inherited by the worker class. This is used to inject new attributes and methods to the worker class for use in collective_rpc calls.

name: --enable-fault-tolerance
description: Enable fault tolerance for detailed error recovery, such as scaling down fault DPEngineCore.

name: --fault-tolerance-config
description: The configurations for fault tolerance.

name: --block-size
description: Size of a contiguous cache block in number of tokens. Accepts None (meaning "use default"). After construction, always int.

name: --gpu-memory-utilization
description: The fraction of GPU memory to be used for the model executor, which can range from 0 to 1. For example, a value of 0.5 would imply 50% GPU memory utilization. If unspecified, will use the default value of 0.92. This is a per-instance limit, and only applies to the current vLLM instance.

name: --kv-cache-memory-bytes
description: Size of KV Cache per GPU in bytes. By default, this is set to None and vllm can automatically infer the kv cache size based on gpu_memory_utilization. However, users may want to manually specify the kv cache memory size.

name: --kv-cache-dtype
description: Data type for kv cache storage. If "auto", will use model data type. CUDA 11.8+ supports fp8 (=fp8_e4m3) and fp8_e5m2. ROCm (AMD GPU) supports fp8 (=fp8_e4m3). Intel Gaudi (HPU) supports fp8 (using fp8_inc). Some models (namely DeepSeekV3.

name: --num-gpu-blocks-override
description: Number of GPU blocks to use. This overrides the profiled `num_gpu_blocks` if specified. Does nothing if `None`. Used for testing preemption.

name: --prefix-caching-hash-algo
description: Set the hash algorithm for prefix caching: - "sha256" uses Pickle for object serialization before hashing. This is the current default, as SHA256 is the most secure choice to avoid potential hash collisions. - "sha256_cbor" provides a reproducible, cross-language compatible hash.

name: --prefix-cache-retention-interval
description: Token interval between retained sliding-window and Mamba prefix-cache checkpoints. ``0`` retains only semantic checkpoints, including the latest replay boundary and shared-prefix junctions.

name: --kv-cache-dtype-skip-layers
description: Layer patterns to skip KV cache quantization. Accepts layer indices (e.g., '0', '2', '4') or attention type names (e.g., 'sliding_window').

name: --kv-sharing-fast-prefill
description: In some KV sharing setups, e.g. YOCO (https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.05254), some layers can skip tokens corresponding to prefill. This flag enables attention metadata for eligible layers to be overridden with metadata necessary for implementing this optimization in some models (e.g. Gemma3n)

name: --mamba-cache-dtype
description: The data type to use for the Mamba cache (both the conv as well as the ssm state). If set to 'auto', the data type will be inferred from the model config.

name: --mamba-ssm-cache-dtype
description: The data type to use for the Mamba cache (ssm state only, conv state will still be controlled by mamba_cache_dtype). If set to 'auto', the data type for the ssm state will be determined by mamba_cache_dtype.

name: --mamba-block-size
description: Size of a contiguous cache block in number of tokens for mamba cache. Can be set only when prefix caching is enabled. Value must be a multiple of 8 to align with causal_conv1d kernel.

name: --prefix-match-unit
description: The finest token boundary (in tokens) a prefix-cache hit can land on. Prefix-cache keys are computed every `prefix_match_unit` tokens. It can be set finer than the physical KV cache block sizes (e.g.

name: --mamba-cache-mode
description: The cache strategy for Mamba layers: - "none": set when prefix caching is disabled. - "all": cache the mamba state of all tokens at position i * block_size. - "align": only cache the mamba state of the last token of each scheduler step and when the token is at position i * block_size.

name: --enable-mamba-fine-grained-prefix-cache
description: Also register a Mamba "align" checkpoint at the shared-prefix junction -- where an EAGLE/MTP sibling was observed to resume -- instead of only at the prompt tail.

name: --replayssm-buffer-len
description: ReplaySSM logical history length B for Mamba2. Triton uses B physical rows and FlashInfer uses B+1. Kimi-K3 speculative decode does not use B. Default 16.

name: --use-replayssm
description: Use the ReplaySSM Mamba2 decode kernel: cache recent SSM inputs and skip the per-step full-state store, writing the checkpoint back only on flush. Requires mamba_cache_mode 'none' or 'align' (prefix caching) and the Triton or FlashInfer mamba backend; standard (non-speculative) decode only.

name: --kv-offloading-size
description: Size of the KV cache offloading buffer in GiB. When TP > 1, this is the total buffer size summed across all TP ranks. By default, this is set to None, which means no KV offloading is enabled. When set, vLLM will enable KV cache offloading to CPU using the kv_offloading_backend.

name: --kv-offloading-backend
description: The backend to use for KV cache offloading. Supported backends include 'native' (vLLM native CPU offloading), 'lmcache'. KV offloading is only activated when kv_offloading_size is set.

name: --offload-backend
description: The backend for weight offloading. Options: - "auto": Selects based on which sub-config has non-default values (prefetch if offload_group_size > 0, uva if cpu_offload_gb > 0). - "uva": UVA (Unified Virtual Addressing) zero-copy offloading.

name: --cpu-offload-gb
description: The space in GiB to offload to CPU, per GPU. Default is 0, which means no offloading. Intuitively, this argument can be seen as a virtual way to increase the GPU memory size. For example, if you have one 24 GB GPU and set this to 10, virtually you can think of it as a 34 GB GPU.

name: --cpu-offload-params
description: The set of parameter name segments to target for CPU offloading. Unmatched parameters are not offloaded. If this set is empty, parameters are offloaded non-selectively until the memory limit defined by `cpu_offload_gb` is reached. Examples: - For parameter name "mlp.experts.

name: --offload-group-size
description: Group every N layers together. Offload last `offload_num_in_group` layers of each group. Default is 0 (disabled). Example: group_size=8, num_in_group=2 offloads layers 6,7,14,15,22,23,... Unlike cpu_offload_gb, this uses explicit async prefetching to hide transfer latency.

name: --offload-num-in-group
description: Number of layers to offload per group. Must be <= offload_group_size. Default is 1.

name: --offload-prefetch-step
description: Number of layers to prefetch ahead. Higher values hide more latency but use more GPU memory. Default is 1.

name: --offload-params
description: The set of parameter name segments to target for prefetch offloading. Unmatched parameters are not offloaded. If this set is empty, ALL parameters of each offloaded layer are offloaded. Uses segment matching: "w13_weight" matches "mlp.experts.w13_weight" but not "mlp.experts.w13_weight_scale".

name: --language-model-only
description: If True, disables all multimodal inputs by setting all modality limits to 0. Equivalent to setting `--limit-mm-per-prompt` to 0 for every modality.

name: --limit-mm-per-prompt
description: The maximum number of input items and options allowed per prompt for each modality. Defaults to 999 for each modality.

name: --enable-mm-embeds
description: If `True`, enables passing multimodal embeddings: for `LLM` class, this refers to tensor inputs under `multi_modal_data`; for the OpenAI-compatible server, this refers to chat messages with content `"type": "*_embeds"`.

name: --media-io-kwargs
description: Additional args passed to process media inputs, keyed by modalities. For example, to set num_frames for video, set `--media-io-kwargs '{"video": {"num_frames": 40} }'`

name: --mm-processor-kwargs
description: Arguments to be forwarded to the model's processor for multi-modal data, e.g., image processor. Overrides for the multi-modal processor obtained from `transformers.AutoProcessor.from_pretrained`. The available overrides depend on the model that is being run.

name: --mm-processor-cache-gb
description: The size (in GiB) of the multi-modal processor cache, which is used to avoid re-processing past multi-modal inputs. This cache is duplicated for each API process and engine core process, resulting in a total memory usage of `mm_processor_cache_gb * (api_server_count + data_parallel_size)`.

name: --mm-processor-cache-type
description: Type of cache to use for the multi-modal preprocessor/mapper. If `shm`, use shared memory FIFO cache. If `lru`, use mirrored LRU cache.

name: --mm-hasher-algorithm
description: Hash algorithm to use for multi-modal input caching. Use `"sha256"` or `"sha512"` for FIPS-compliant deployments.

name: --mm-shm-cache-max-object-size-mb
description: Size limit (in MiB) for each object stored in the multi-modal processor shared memory cache. Only effective when `mm_processor_cache_type` is `"shm"`.

name: --mm-encoder-only
description: When enabled, skips the language component of the model. This is usually only valid in disaggregated Encoder process.

name: --mm-encoder-tp-mode
description: Indicates how to optimize multi-modal encoder inference using tensor parallelism (TP). - `"weights"`: Within the same vLLM engine, split the weights of each layer across TP ranks.

name: --mm-encoder-attn-backend
description: Optional override for the multi-modal encoder attention backend when using vision transformers. Accepts any value from `vllm.v1.attention.backends.registry.AttentionBackendEnum` (e.g. `FLASH_ATTN`).

name: --mm-encoder-attn-dtype
description: Optional dtype override for ViT encoder attention. Set to `"fp8"` to enable FP8 quantization via the FlashInfer cuDNN backend. When set to `"fp8"` without a scale file, dynamic scaling is used automatically. See docs/features/quantization/fp8_vit_attn.md for details.

name: --mm-encoder-fp8-scale-path
description: Path to a JSON file containing per-layer FP8 Q/K/V scales for ViT encoder attention. When provided (with `mm_encoder_attn_dtype="fp8"`), static scaling is used. When omitted, dynamic scaling is used.

name: --mm-encoder-fp8-scale-save-path
description: When set with dynamic FP8 scaling (`mm_encoder_attn_dtype="fp8"` and no `mm_encoder_fp8_scale_path`), saves the calibrated scales to this file after the amax history buffer is full. The saved file can then be used as `mm_encoder_fp8_scale_path` in subsequent runs.

name: --mm-encoder-fp8-scale-save-margin
description: Safety margin multiplied onto scales when auto-saving. A value > 1 leaves headroom so that inputs with larger activations than the calibration set do not overflow FP8 range. Default 1.5.

name: --interleave-mm-strings
description: Enable fully interleaved support for multimodal prompts, while using --chat-template-content-format=string.

name: --skip-mm-profiling
description: When enabled, skips multimodal memory profiling and only profiles with language backbone model during engine initialization. This reduces engine startup time but shifts the responsibility to users for estimating the peak memory usage of the activation of multimodal encoder and embedding cache.

name: --video-pruning-rate
description: Fraction of video tokens to prune from each video. Value sits in range [0;1); pruning is enabled when it is greater than 0. The pruning algorithm is selected by `video_pruning_method`.

name: --video-pruning-method
description: Video token pruning algorithm applied when `video_pruning_rate` > 0: - "evs": Efficient Video Sampling. - "vidcom2": Video Compression Commander.

name: --mm-tensor-ipc
description: IPC (inter-process communication) method for multimodal tensors. - "direct_rpc": Use msgspec serialization via RPC - "torch_shm": Use torch.multiprocessing shared memory for zero-copy IPC Defaults to "direct_rpc".

name: --mm-ipc-gpu-memory-gb
description: Amount of GPU memory (in GiB) sequestered on the engine's device for GPU-side multimodal work in the API-server (frontend) process, such as hardware video decoding.

name: --enable-lora
description: If True, enable handling of LoRA adapters.

name: --max-loras
description: Max number of LoRAs in a single batch.

name: --max-lora-rank
description: Max LoRA rank.

name: --lora-dtype
description: Data type for LoRA. If auto, will default to base model dtype.

name: --enable-tower-connector-lora
description: If `True`, LoRA support for the tower (vision encoder) and connector of multimodal models will be enabled. This is an experimental feature and currently only supports some MM models such as the Qwen VL series. The default is False.

name: --max-cpu-loras
description: Maximum number of LoRAs to store in CPU memory. Must be >= than `max_loras`.

name: --fully-sharded-loras
description: By default, only half of the LoRA computation is sharded with tensor parallelism. Enabling this will use the fully sharded layers. At high sequence length, max rank or tensor parallel size, this is likely faster.

name: --lora-target-modules
description: Restrict LoRA to specific module suffixes (e.g., ["o_proj", "qkv_proj"]). If None, all supported LoRA modules are used. This allows deployment-time control over which modules have LoRA applied, useful for performance tuning.

name: --default-mm-loras
description: Dictionary mapping specific modalities to LoRA model paths; this field is only applicable to multimodal models and should be leveraged when a model always expects a LoRA to be active when a given modality is present.

name: --specialize-active-lora
description: Whether to construct lora kernel grid by the number of active LoRA adapters.

name: --enable-mixed-moe-lora-format
description: If True, force the engine to use the universal 2D MoE LoRA wrapper (`FusedMoEWithLoRA`) regardless of the model's `is_3d_moe_weight` flag, so that 2D-format and 3D-format MoE LoRA adapters can be served in the same deployment. Only meaningful for MoE models; ignored otherwise.

name: --enable-moe-shared-loras
description: If True, load MoE expert adapters in the "shared-outer" layout, where the gate/up (`w1`/`w3`) lora_A and the down (`w2`) lora_B are shared across all experts (stored once with expert-dim 1) instead of per-expert. The shared factors are broadcast to the expert count at kernel time.

name: --show-hidden-metrics-for-version
description: Enable deprecated Prometheus metrics that have been hidden since the specified version. For example, if a previously deprecated metric has been hidden since the v0.7.0 release, you use `--show-hidden-metrics-for-version=0.7` as a temporary escape hatch while you migrate to new metrics.

name: --otlp-traces-endpoint
description: Target URL to which OpenTelemetry traces will be sent.

name: --collect-detailed-traces
description: It makes sense to set this only if `--otlp-traces-endpoint` is set. If set, it will collect detailed traces for the specified modules. This involves use of possibly costly and or blocking operations and hence might have a performance impact.

name: --per-request-spec-decode-metrics
description: Include per-request speculative-decoding acceptance metrics in the response under `metrics.speculative_decoding`.

name: --kv-cache-metrics
description: Enable KV cache residency metrics (lifetime, idle time, reuse gaps). Uses sampling to minimize overhead. Requires log stats to be enabled (i.e., --disable-log-stats not set).

name: --kv-cache-metrics-sample
description: Sampling rate for KV cache metrics (0.0, 1.0]. Default 0.01 = 1% of blocks.

name: --cudagraph-metrics
description: Enable CUDA graph metrics (number of padded/unpadded tokens, runtime cudagraph dispatch modes, and their observed frequencies at every logging interval).

name: --enable-layerwise-nvtx-tracing
description: Enable layerwise NVTX tracing. This traces the execution of each layer or module in the model and attach information such as input/output shapes to nvtx range markers. Noted that this doesn't work with CUDA graphs enabled.

name: --enable-mfu-metrics
description: Enable Model FLOPs Utilization (MFU) metrics.

name: --enable-logging-iteration-details
description: Enable detailed logging of iteration details. If set, vllm EngineCore will log iteration details This includes number of context/generation requests and tokens and the elapsed cpu time for the iteration.

name: --jit-monitor-mode
description: How to handle post-warmup JIT compilation events.

name: --jit-monitor-verbose
description: Log every monitored JIT compile with runtime details. This can emit many logs and add overhead, so it is intended for debugging.

name: --max-num-queued-reqs
description: Maximum number of requests that can be in-flight (waiting or running) at the same time, or None for no limit. When the limit is reached, new requests are rejected with HTTP 503 so the client can retry on another instance.

name: --max-num-queued-tokens
description: Maximum total prompt tokens of requests currently in the prefill phase, or None for no limit. When the limit is reached, new requests are rejected with HTTP 503.

name: --long-prefill-token-threshold
description: For chunked prefill, a request is considered long if the prompt is longer than this number of tokens. 0 disables the cap (default).

name: --scheduling-policy
description: The scheduling policy to use: - "fcfs" means first come first served, i.e. requests are handled in order of arrival. - "priority" means requests are handled based on given priority (lower value means earlier handling) and time of arrival deciding any ties).

name: --disable-chunked-mm-input
description: If set to true and chunked prefill is enabled, we do not want to partially schedule a multimodal item.

name: --scheduler-cls
description: The scheduler class to use. "vllm.v1.core.sched.scheduler.Scheduler" is the default scheduler. Can be a class directly or the path to a class of form "mod.custom_class".

name: --scheduler-reserve-full-isl
description: If True, the scheduler checks whether the full input sequence length fits in the KV cache before admitting a new request, rather than only checking the first chunk. Prevents over-admission and KV cache thrashing with chunked prefill.

name: --watermark
description: Fraction of total KV cache blocks to keep free (the watermark) when admitting waiting or preempted requests into the running queue. This headroom helps avoid frequent KV cache eviction and the resulting repeated preemption of requests when GPU memory is scarce. Must be in the range [0.0, 1.0); 0.

name: --prefill-schedule-interval
description: For data-parallel deployments, only admit new prefill requests once every N engine steps, aligned across DP ranks, to better balance per-step forward-pass times.

name: --disable-hybrid-kv-cache-manager
description: If set to True, KV cache manager will allocate the same size of KV cache for all attention layers even if there are multiple type of attention layers like full attention and sliding window attention.

name: --async-scheduling
description: If set to False, disable async scheduling. Async scheduling helps to avoid gaps in GPU utilization, leading to better latency and throughput.

name: --stream-interval
description: The interval (or buffer size) for streaming in terms of token length. A smaller value (1) makes streaming smoother by sending each token immediately, while a larger value (e.g., 10) reduces host overhead and may increase throughput by batching multiple tokens before sending.

name: --cudagraph-capture-sizes
description: Sizes to capture cudagraph. - None (default): capture sizes are inferred from vllm config. - list[int]: capture sizes are specified as given.

name: --max-cudagraph-capture-size
description: The maximum cudagraph capture size. If cudagraph_capture_sizes is specified, this will be set to the largest size in that list (or checked for consistency if specified).

name: --ir-op-priority
description: vLLM IR op priority for dispatching/lowering during the forward pass. Platform defaults appended automatically during VllmConfig.__post_init__.

name: --enable-flashinfer-autotune
description: If True, run FlashInfer autotuning during kernel warmup.

name: --speculative-config
description: Speculative decoding configuration.

name: --spec-method
description: The name of the speculative method to use. If users provide and set the `model` param, the speculative method type will be detected automatically if possible, if `model` param is not provided, the method name must be provided.

name: --spec-model
description: The name of the draft model, eagle head, or additional weights, if provided.

name: --spec-tokens
description: The number of speculative tokens, if provided. It will default to the number in the draft model config if present, otherwise, it is required.

name: --watermark-config
description: Text watermarking configuration.

name: --diffusion-config
description: Diffusion LLM (dLLM) configuration.

name: --kv-transfer-config
description: The configurations for distributed KV cache transfer.

name: --kv-events-config
description: The configurations for event publishing.

name: --ec-transfer-config
description: The configurations for distributed EC cache transfer.

name: --ec-manager-config
description: The configurations for custom encoder cache manager.

name: --compilation-config
description: `torch.compile` and cudagraph capture configuration for the model. As a shorthand, one can append compilation arguments via -cc.parameter=argument such as `-cc.mode=3` (same as `-cc='{"mode":3}'`).

name: --attention-config
description: Attention configuration.

name: --engram-config
description: N-gram embedding storage and sharding settings.

name: --reasoning-config
description: The configurations for reasoning model.

name: --kernel-config
description: Kernel configuration.

name: --additional-config
description: Additional config for specified platform. Different platforms may support different configs. Make sure the configs are valid for the platform you are using. Contents must be hashable.

name: --structured-outputs-config
description: Structured outputs configuration.

name: --profiler-config
description: Profiling configuration.

name: --optimization-level
description: The optimization level. These levels trade startup time cost for performance, with -O0 having the best startup time and -O3 having the best performance. -O2 is used by default. See OptimizationLevel for full description.

name: --performance-mode
description: Performance mode for runtime behavior, 'balanced' is the default. 'interactivity' favors low end-to-end per-request latency at small batch sizes (fine-grained CUDA graphs, latency-oriented kernels).

name: --weight-transfer-config
description: The configurations for weight transfer during RL training.

name: --disable-log-stats
description: Disable logging statistics.

name: --aggregate-engine-logging
description: Log aggregate rather than per-engine statistics

name: --fail-on-environ-validation
description: If set, the engine will raise an error if

name: --shutdown-timeout
description: Shutdown timeout in seconds. 0 = abort, >0 = wait.

name: --gdn-prefill-backend
description: Select GDN prefill backend.

name: --kda-prefill-backend
description: Select KDA prefill backend. 'flashkda' is CUDA-only and

name: --kda-decode-backend
description: Select KDA decode backend.

name: CUDA_HOME
description: path to cudatoolkit home directory, under which should be bin, include,; and lib directories.

name: VLLM_MOE_ROUTING_SIMULATION_STRATEGY
description: MoE routing strategy selector.; See `RoutingSimulator.get_available_strategies()` # for available; strategies.; Custom routing strategies can be registered by; RoutingSimulator.register_strategy(); Note: custom strategies may not produce correct model outputs

name: VLLM_PROCESS_NAME_PREFIX
description: Used to set the process name prefix for vLLM processes.; This is useful for debugging and monitoring purposes.; The default value is "VLLM".

name: VLLM_USE_SIMPLE_KV_OFFLOAD
description: Enable simple KV offload.

name: VLLM_USE_SPINLOOP_EXT
description: If set to 1, use Python spinloop extension to poll in a more efficient; way when using the mp backend.

name: pooler.task
description: The task used for pooling.

name: pooler.pooling_type
description: The pooling method used for pooling. If set, `seq_pooling_type` or `tok_pooling_type` are automatically populated with this field. Alternatively, users can set `seq_pooling_type` and `tok_pooling_type` explicitly. This field is mainly for user convenience.

name: pooler.seq_pooling_type
description: The pooling method used for sequence pooling.

name: pooler.tok_pooling_type
description: The pooling method used for tokenwise pooling.

name: pooler.use_activation
description: Whether to apply activation function to the pooler outputs. `None` uses the pooler's default, which is `True` in most cases.

name: pooler.dimensions
description: Reduce the dimensions of embeddings if model support matryoshka representation. Defaults to None.

name: pooler.enable_chunked_processing
description: Whether to enable chunked processing for long inputs that exceed the model's maximum position embeddings. When enabled, long inputs will be split into chunks, processed separately, and then aggregated using weighted averaging.

name: pooler.max_embed_len
description: Maximum input length allowed for embedding generation. When set, allows inputs longer than max_embed_len to be accepted for embedding models. When an input exceeds max_embed_len, it will be handled according to the original max_model_len validation logic. Defaults to None (i.e.

name: pooler.logit_mean
description: If provided, subtract this value from classification logits before activation. Used for affine score calibration (Platt scaling): activation((logit - logit_mean) / logit_sigma). Defaults to None.

name: pooler.logit_sigma
description: If provided, divide the classification logits by this value after mean subtraction. Used for affine score calibration (Platt scaling): activation((logit - logit_mean) / logit_sigma). Defaults to None.

name: pooler.step_tag_id
description: If set, only the score corresponding to the `step_tag_id` in the generated sentence should be returned. Otherwise, the scores for all tokens are returned.

name: pooler.returned_token_ids
description: A list of indices for the vocabulary dimensions to be extracted, such as the token IDs of `good_token` and `bad_token` in the `math-shepherd-mistral-7b-prm` model.

name: eplb.window_size
description: Window size for expert load recording.

name: eplb.step_interval
description: Interval for rearranging experts in expert parallelism. Note that if this is greater than the EPLB window size, only the metrics of the last `lb_window_size` steps will be used for rearranging experts.

name: eplb.num_redundant_experts
description: Number of redundant experts to use for expert parallelism.

name: eplb.log_balancedness
description: Log the balancedness each step of expert parallelism. This is turned off by default since it will cause communication overhead.

name: eplb.log_balancedness_interval
description: Interval for logging the balancedness.

name: eplb.use_async
description: Whether to use non-blocking EPLB.

name: eplb.policy
description: The policy type for expert parallel load balancing (EPLB).

name: eplb.communicator
description: Backend for EPLB expert weight communication: - "torch_nccl": Use torch.distributed on the device process group - "torch_gloo": Use torch.

name: fault_tolerance.engine_recovery_timeout_sec
description: Timeout (in seconds) to wait for error handling instructions before raising an exception. If the EngineCore encounters an error, it waits up to this many seconds for vLLM to receive instructions on how to handle the error and then recover from the fault.

name: speculative.enforce_eager
description: Override the default enforce_eager from model_config

name: speculative.num_speculative_tokens
description: The number of speculative tokens, if provided. It will default to the number in the draft model config if present, otherwise, it is required.

name: speculative.model
description: The name of the draft model, eagle head, or additional weights, if provided.

name: speculative.method
description: The name of the speculative method to use. If users provide and set the `model` param, the speculative method type will be detected automatically if possible, if `model` param is not provided, the method name must be provided.

name: speculative.draft_tensor_parallel_size
description: The degree of the tensor parallelism for the draft model. Can only be 1 or the same as the target model's tensor parallel size.

name: speculative.tensor_parallel_size
description: Users should pass "draft_tensor_parallel_size". This parameter's purpose is to warn users when they mistakenly provide the wrong argument.

name: speculative.quantization
description: Quantization method that was used to quantize the draft model weights. If `None`, we assume the model weights are not quantized. Note that it only takes effect when using the draft model-based speculative method.

name: speculative.moe_backend
description: MoE backend to use for the draft model. When `None`, the draft model inherits the target model's `--moe-backend` setting. Useful when the drafter and generator require different MoE kernels (e.g. quantized generator with unquantized drafter).

name: speculative.attention_backend
description: Attention backend to use for the draft model. When `None`, the backend is automatically selected. Useful when the drafter requires a different attention backend (e.g. DFlash needs a backend that supports non-causal attention).

name: speculative.kv_cache_dtype
description: KV cache dtype for the draft model. When `None`, the draft inherits the target model's `--kv-cache-dtype`.

name: speculative.max_model_len
description: The maximum model length of the draft model. Used when testing the ability to skip speculation for some sequences.

name: speculative.revision
description: The specific model version to use for the draft model. It can be a branch name, a tag name, or a commit id. If unspecified, will use the default version.

name: speculative.code_revision
description: The specific revision to use for the draft model code on Hugging Face Hub. It can be a branch name, a tag name, or a commit id. If unspecified, will use the default version.

name: speculative.index_share_for_mtp_iteration
description: Override whether MTP iterations reuse the first step's sparse indices. If `None`, use the value from the draft model's Hugging Face config.

name: speculative.disable_padded_drafter_batch
description: Disable input padding for speculative decoding. If set to True, speculative input batches can contain sequences of different lengths, which may only be supported by certain attention backends. This currently only affects the EAGLE method of speculation.

name: speculative.disable_eagle_block_drop
description: Disable dropping the trailing prefix-cache block for EAGLE-like speculative methods. This is an experimental option for measuring the acceptance-rate impact of reusing that block. It does not disable the speculative drafter itself.

name: speculative.use_local_argmax_reduction
description: Use vocab-parallel local argmax instead of all-gathering full logits for draft token generation. Reduces communication from O(vocab_size) to O(2 * tp_size) per token. Only applies to greedy draft selection in non-tree speculation.

name: speculative.use_heterogeneous_vocab
description: Allow draft and target models to use different vocabularies. When enabled, builds a token-level intersection at init and constrains draft logits to shared tokens only (TLI algorithm). Requires method='draft_model'.

name: speculative.prompt_lookup_max
description: Maximum size of ngram token window when using Ngram proposer, required when method is set to ngram.

name: speculative.prompt_lookup_min
description: Minimum size of ngram token window when using Ngram proposer, if provided. Defaults to 1.

name: speculative.parallel_drafting
description: Enable parallel drafting, where all speculative tokens are generated in parallel rather than sequentially. This can improve performance but requires the speculative model be trained to support parallel drafting. Only compatible with EAGLE and draft model methods.

name: speculative.target_model_config
description: The configuration of the target model.

name: speculative.target_parallel_config
description: The parallel configuration for the target model.

name: speculative.num_speculative_tokens_per_batch_size
description: Batch-size schedule used to dynamically choose speculative-token count. Each entry is ``(range_start, range_end, num_speculative_tokens)`` with an inclusive batch-size range.

name: speculative.draft_model_config
description: The configuration of the draft model initialized internal.

name: speculative.draft_parallel_config
description: The parallel configuration for the draft model initialized internal.

name: speculative.suffix_decoding_max_tree_depth
description: The maximum depth of the suffix decoding global and prompt trees. The tree depth limits the sum of the prefix match and speculation lengths.

name: speculative.suffix_decoding_max_cached_requests
description: The maximum number of requests to cache in the global suffix tree. If exceeded, will trigger eviction in FIFO order. If set to 0, the global suffix tree is disabled and past responses are not cached (prompt trees are still used).

name: speculative.suffix_decoding_max_spec_factor
description: The maximum spec factor for suffix decoding. The spec factor controls speculation lengths based on the prefix match length: max_spec_tokens = max_spec_factor * prefix_match_length.

name: speculative.suffix_decoding_min_token_prob
description: The minimum token probability for suffix decoding. Will only speculate tokens with estimated probability (based on frequency counts) greater than or equal to this value.

name: speculative.draft_load_config.load_format
description: The format of the model weights to load. - "auto" will try to load the weights in the safetensors format and fall back to the pytorch bin format if safetensors format is not available. - "pt" will load the weights in the pytorch bin format.

name: speculative.draft_load_config.download_dir
description: Directory to download and load the weights, default to the default cache directory of Hugging Face.

name: speculative.draft_load_config.safetensors_load_strategy
description: Specifies the loading strategy for safetensors weights. - None (default): Uses memory-mapped (lazy) loading. When an NFS filesystem is detected and the total checkpoint size fits within 90%% of available RAM, prefetching is enabled automatically. - "lazy": Weights are memory-mapped from the file.

name: speculative.draft_load_config.safetensors_prefetch_num_threads
description: Number of worker threads used to prefetch safetensors checkpoint files into the OS page cache when safetensors prefetching is enabled.

name: speculative.draft_load_config.safetensors_prefetch_block_size
description: Read size in bytes for each safetensors checkpoint file prefetch.

name: speculative.draft_load_config.model_loader_extra_config
description: Extra config for model loader. This will be passed to the model loader corresponding to the chosen load_format.

name: speculative.draft_load_config.device
description: Device to which model weights will be loaded, default to device_config.device

name: speculative.draft_load_config.ignore_patterns
description: The list of patterns to ignore when loading the model. Default to "original/**/*" to avoid repeated loading of llama's checkpoints.

name: speculative.draft_load_config.use_tqdm_on_load
description: Whether to enable tqdm for showing progress bar when loading model weights.

name: speculative.draft_load_config.pt_load_map_location
description: The map location for loading pytorch checkpoint, to support loading checkpoints can only be loaded on certain devices like "cuda", this is equivalent to `{"": "cuda"}`. Another supported format is mapping from different devices like from GPU 1 to GPU 0: `{"cuda:1": "cuda:0"}`.

name: speculative.rejection_sample_method
description: The rejection sampling method to use. 'standard' uses probabilistic rejection sampling (with or without cached draft logits, controlled by draft_sample_method). 'synthetic' accepts draft tokens with a decaying probability calibrated to synthetic_acceptance_rate.

name: speculative.synthetic_acceptance_rates
description: Per-position *unconditional* acceptance rates for synthetic rejection sampling. Position i's entry is the marginal probability that the first i+1 draft tokens are all accepted; the list must have length num_speculative_tokens, each entry in [0, 1], and be monotonically non-increasing.

name: speculative.synthetic_acceptance_length
description: Target mean acceptance length for synthetic rejection sampling, in [1, num_speculative_tokens + 1]. Resolved internally to synthetic_acceptance_rates. Only valid when rejection_sample_method is 'synthetic'. Mutually exclusive with synthetic_acceptance_rates.

name: speculative.enable_adaptive_verification
description: Whether to adaptively size the draft-verification budget from per-request confidence. Currently only supported for method="dspark".

name: speculative.draft_sample_method
description: How the draft model samples tokens. 'greedy' always picks the argmax token, and the draft probabilities are treated as one-hot during rejection sampling.

name: speculative.dspark_draft_topk
description: For Qwen3 DSpark drafting, evaluate the Markov projection only for the top-k base-logit candidates. Requires draft tensor parallel size 1.

name: watermark.key
description: Secret key used to watermark generated text.

name: watermark.algorithm
description: Algorithm used to watermark generated text.

name: watermark.alpha
description: Probability of selecting key B for dual-key watermarking.

name: watermark.context_width
description: Number of prior tokens used by the watermark PRF.

name: watermark.deduplicate_contexts
description: Which history is searched for a repeated context before a token is sampled; a repeated context is sampled without the watermark. `none` disables the search. `single_turn` (default) searches this request's generated tokens.

name: watermark.deduplicate_contexts_max_history
description: Number of most recent history positions searched (default 8192), or `None` for the whole scope. Each position is compared over the `context_width` tokens before it. Ignored when `deduplicate_contexts` is `none`.

name: watermark.prf
description: Pseudorandom function used by the watermarking algorithm.

name: watermark.allow_target_only_watermarking
description: Allow speculative decoding without watermarking draft tokens.

name: diffusion.canvas_length
description: Length of the denoising canvas (block). Also determines the number of speculative tokens scheduled per step.

name: diffusion.max_denoising_steps
description: Maximum number of denoising iterations per canvas block. If not set, read from the model's generation_config.json.

name: kv_transfer.kv_connector
description: The KV connector for vLLM to transmit KV caches between vLLM instances.

name: kv_transfer.engine_id
description: The engine id for KV transfers.

name: kv_transfer.kv_buffer_device
description: The device used by kv connector to buffer the KV cache. Choices are 'cuda', 'cpu' and 'xpu'.

name: kv_transfer.kv_buffer_size
description: The buffer size for TorchDistributedConnector. Measured in number of bytes. Recommended value: 1e9 (about 1GB).

name: kv_transfer.kv_role
description: Whether this vLLM instance produces, consumes KV cache, or both. Choices are 'kv_producer', 'kv_consumer', and 'kv_both'.

name: kv_transfer.kv_rank
description: The rank of this vLLM instance in the KV cache transfer. Typical value: 0 for prefill instance, 1 for decode instance. Currently only 1P1D is supported.

name: kv_transfer.kv_parallel_size
description: The number of parallel instances for KV cache transfer.

name: kv_transfer.kv_ip
description: The KV connector ip, used to build distributed connection.

name: kv_transfer.kv_port
description: The KV connector port, used to build distributed connection.

name: kv_transfer.kv_connector_extra_config
description: any extra config that the connector may need.

name: kv_transfer.kv_connector_module_path
description: The Python module path to dynamically load the KV connector from. Only supported in V1.

name: kv_transfer.enable_permute_local_kv
description: Experiment feature flag to enable HND to NHD KV Transfer

name: kv_transfer.kv_load_failure_policy
description: Policy for handling KV cache load failures. 'recompute': reschedule the request to recompute failed blocks 'fail': immediately fail the request with an error finish reason (default)

name: kv_events.enable_kv_cache_events
description: If True, enable KV cache events for tracking block storage and removal. Events can be published externally by zmq using the event publisher config.

name: kv_events.publisher
description: The publisher to use for publishing kv events. Can be "null", "zmq".

name: kv_events.endpoint
description: The zmq endpoint to use for publishing kv events.

name: kv_events.replay_endpoint
description: The zmq endpoint to use for replaying kv events.

name: kv_events.buffer_steps
description: The number of steps to cache for replay endpoint. Will only save events from the last N steps for the replay endpoint.

name: kv_events.hwm
description: The zmq high water mark for the event publisher. After queueing N events, events will start dropping if the consumer is not keeping up.

name: kv_events.max_queue_size
description: The maximum number of events to queue while waiting for publishing.

name: kv_events.topic
description: The topic to use for the event publisher. Consumers can subscribe to this topic to receive events.

name: ec_transfer.ec_connector
description: The EC connector for vLLM to transmit EC caches between vLLM instances.

name: ec_transfer.engine_id
description: The engine id for EC transfers.

name: ec_transfer.ec_buffer_device
description: The device used by ec connector to buffer the EC cache. Currently only support 'cuda'.

name: ec_transfer.ec_buffer_size
description: The buffer size for TorchDistributedConnector. Measured in number of bytes. Recommended value: 1e9 (about 1GB).

name: ec_transfer.ec_role
description: Whether this vLLM instance produces, consumes EC cache, or both. Choices are 'ec_producer', 'ec_consumer', 'ec_both'.

name: ec_transfer.ec_rank
description: The rank of this vLLM instance in the EC cache transfer. Typical value: 0 for encoder, 1 for pd instance. Currently only 1P1D is supported.

name: ec_transfer.ec_parallel_size
description: The number of parallel instances for EC cache transfer. For PyNcclConnector, this should be 2.

name: ec_transfer.ec_ip
description: The EC connector ip, used to build distributed connection.

name: ec_transfer.ec_port
description: The EC connector port, used to build distributed connection.

name: ec_transfer.ec_connector_extra_config
description: any extra config that the connector may need.

name: ec_transfer.ec_connector_module_path
description: The Python module path to dynamically load the EC connector from. Only supported in V1.

name: compilation.mode
description: The compilation approach used for torch.compile-based compilation of the model. - None: If None, we will select the default compilation mode. For V1 engine this is 3. - 0: NONE: No torch.compile compilation is applied, model runs in fully eager pytorch mode. The model runs as-is.

name: compilation.debug_dump_path
description: The path to dump the debug information.

name: compilation.cache_dir
description: The directory to store the compiled graph, to accelerate Inductor compilation. By default, it will use model-related information to generate a cache directory.

name: compilation.compile_cache_save_format
description: Format for saving torch compile cache: - "binary": saves as binary file (multiprocess safe) - "unpacked": saves as directory structure for inspection/debugging (NOT multiprocess safe) Defaults to `VLLM_COMPILE_CACHE_SAVE_FORMAT` if not specified.

name: compilation.backend
description: The backend for compilation. It needs to be a string: - "" (empty string): use the default backend ("inductor" on CUDA-alike platforms). - "eager"/"openxla"/...: use the specified backend registered in PyTorch. - "full.module.name": a qualified name which can be used to import the backend function.

name: compilation.custom_ops
description: Fine-grained control over which custom ops to enable/disable. Use 'all' to enable all, 'none' to disable all. Also specify a list of custom op names to enable (prefixed with a '+'), or disable (prefixed with a '-').

name: compilation.ir_enable_torch_wrap
description: If True, enable vllm_ir torch custom op wrapping during the forward pass. When False, torch custom op wrapping is disabled, allowing Dynamo to trace the selected implementation directly or avoiding torch custom op overhead in eager mode.

name: compilation.splitting_ops
description: A list of ops to exclude from cudagraphs, used in piecewise compilation. The behavior depends on use_inductor_graph_partition: - When use_inductor_graph_partition=False (default): These ops are used for Dynamo FX-level graph splitting.

name: compilation.compile_mm_encoder
description: Whether or not to compile the multimodal encoder. Currently, this only works for `Qwen2_5_vl` and `mLLaMa4` models on selected platforms. It may also work for models loaded with the Transformers modeling backend if the encoder is compilable.

name: compilation.cudagraph_mm_encoder
description: Enable CUDA graph capture for multimodal encoder (ViT). When enabled, captures full encoder forward as CUDA graph for each token budget level.

name: compilation.encoder_cudagraph_token_budgets
description: Token budget levels for encoder CUDA graph capture. Each budget defines a fixed token capacity. At runtime, images are greedy-packed into the smallest fitting budget and the corresponding CUDA graph is replayed.

name: compilation.encoder_cudagraph_max_vision_items_per_batch
description: Maximum number of images/videos per batch for encoder CUDA graph capture. Determines the fixed batch size used during graph capture. If 0 (default), auto-inferred as max_budget // min_budget from the model's budget range. User-provided positive value overrides auto-inference.

name: compilation.encoder_cudagraph_max_frames_per_batch
description: Maximum total video frames per batch for encoder CUDA graph capture. Controls the cu_seqlens buffer size (one entry per attention sequence, i.e. one per video frame).

name: compilation.compile_sizes
description: Sizes to compile for inductor. In addition to integers, it also supports "cudagraph_capture_sizes" to specify the sizes for cudagraph capture.

name: compilation.compile_ranges_endpoints
description: Endpoints for Inductor compile ranges. The compile ranges are [1, endpoints[0]], [endpoints[0] + 1, endpoints[1]], ..., [endpoints[-1] + 1, max_num_batched_tokens]. Compile sizes are also used single element ranges, the range is represented as [compile_sizes[i], compile_sizes[i]].

name: compilation.inductor_compile_config
description: Additional configurations for inductor. - None: use default configurations.

name: compilation.inductor_passes
description: Additional passes for inductor. It is a dictionary from pass name to pass function qualified name. We use function name because the config uses JSON format. If we pass the config from Python, functions can also be passed directly via Python object constructor, e.g.

name: compilation.cudagraph_mode
description: The mode of the cudagraph: - NONE, no cudagraph capture. - PIECEWISE. - FULL. - FULL_DECODE_ONLY. - FULL_AND_PIECEWISE. (v1 default) PIECEWISE mode build piecewise cudagraph only, keeping the cudagraph incompatible ops (i.e. some attention ops) outside the cudagraph for general flexibility.

name: compilation.cudagraph_num_of_warmups
description: Number of warmup runs for cudagraph. It means the first several runs will be treated as warmup runs. Only after that, the execution will be recorded, and the recorded cudagraph will be used for subsequent runs.

name: compilation.cudagraph_capture_sizes
description: Sizes to capture cudagraph. - None (default): capture sizes are inferred from vllm config. - list[int]: capture sizes are specified as given.

name: compilation.cudagraph_copy_inputs
description: Whether to copy input tensors for cudagraph. If the caller can guarantee that the same input buffers are always used, it can set this to False. Otherwise, it should set this to True, and the compiler will copy the input to an internally managed buffer. Default is False.

name: compilation.cudagraph_specialize_lora
description: Whether to create separate cuda graphs for cases with and without active LoRA adapters. When set to False, the LoRA-enabled cuda graph will be used for all cases, incurring the overhead of running LoRA ops even when no adapters are active.

name: compilation.use_inductor_graph_partition
description: Use inductor graph partition to split the graph at cudagraph_unsafe ops. This partition happens at inductor codegen time after all passes and fusions are finished.

name: compilation.pass_config.fuse_norm_quant
description: Fuse the custom RMSNorm + quant ops.

name: compilation.pass_config.fuse_act_quant
description: Fuse the custom SiluMul + quant ops.

name: compilation.pass_config.fuse_attn_quant
description: Fuse the custom Attention and MLAAttention + quant ops.

name: compilation.pass_config.eliminate_noops
description: Eliminate no-op ops.

name: compilation.pass_config.enable_sp
description: Enable sequence parallelism. Requires TP>1. Automatically disabled if the model's hidden_size is too small for SP to be beneficial (threshold is device-capability dependent).

name: compilation.pass_config.fuse_gemm_comms
description: Enable async TP.

name: compilation.pass_config.fuse_allreduce_rms
description: Enable flashinfer allreduce fusion.

name: compilation.pass_config.enable_qk_norm_rope_fusion
description: Enable fused Q/K RMSNorm + RoPE pass.

name: compilation.pass_config.fuse_rope_kvcache_cat_mla
description: Enable fused MLA KV cache update with RoPE.

name: compilation.pass_config.fuse_act_padding
description: Fuse the custom RMSNorm + padding ops.

name: compilation.pass_config.fuse_mla_dual_rms_norm
description: Fuse paired q/kv RMS norms in MLA attention.

name: compilation.pass_config.fuse_rope_kvcache
description: Fuse the QK rope + KV cache ops.

name: compilation.pass_config.fuse_qk_norm_rope_kvcache
description: Fuse QK RMSNorm + RoPE + KV cache update into a single AITER HIP kernel. Supersedes both enable_qk_norm_rope_fusion and fuse_rope_kvcache for layers that support it. Auto-enabled at O1+ on ROCm for models with QK-norm (e.g. Qwen3-MoE).

name: compilation.pass_config.rope_kvcache_fusion_max_token_num
description: The threshold for ROCm AITER RoPE+KVCache fusion e.g. for small batch decode. Larger batch sizes e.g. during prefill will use the unfused kernels. Also applies to the fused QK-Norm+RoPE+KVCache pass.

name: compilation.pass_config.fi_allreduce_fusion_max_size_mb
description: The threshold of the communicated tensor sizes under which vllm should use flashinfer fused allreduce. Specified as a float in MB. Unspecified will fallback to default values which are compute capability and world size dependent.

name: compilation.pass_config.sp_min_token_num
description: The minimum number of tokens above which vllm should use sequence parallelism. Specified as an integer token count. Unspecified will fallback to default values which are compute capability and world size dependent.

name: compilation.max_cudagraph_capture_size
description: The maximum cudagraph capture size. If cudagraph_capture_sizes is specified, this will be set to the largest size in that list (or checked for consistency if specified).

name: compilation.dynamic_shapes_config.type
description: Controls the type of dynamic shapes handling to use with torch.compile(). - BACKED: Default PyTorch behavior with potential guards ignored. - UNBACKED: No guards guaranteed (most sound) but may throw data dependent errors. - BACKED_SIZE_OBLIVIOUS: Experimental safer alternative to backed/unbacked.

name: compilation.dynamic_shapes_config.evaluate_guards
description: A debug mode to detect and fail if Dynamo ever specializes a dynamic shape by guarding on it. When True, dynamic shape guards are not dropped from dynamo. And a failure will be triggered if a recompilation ever happens due to that. This mode requires VLLM_USE_BYTECODE_HOOK to be 0.

name: compilation.dynamic_shapes_config.assume_32_bit_indexing
description: whether all tensor sizes can use 32 bit indexing. `True` requires PyTorch 2.10+

name: compilation.local_cache_dir
description: local cache dir for each rank

name: compilation.fast_moe_cold_start
description: Optimization for fast MOE cold start. This is a bit of a hack that assumes that: 1. the only decoder forward pass being run is the current model 2.

name: compilation.enabled_custom_ops
description: custom ops that are enabled

name: compilation.disabled_custom_ops
description: custom ops that are disabled

name: compilation.traced_files
description: files that are traced for compilation

name: compilation.compilation_time
description: time taken for compilation

name: compilation.encoder_compilation_time
description: time taken for multimodal encoder compilation

name: compilation.static_forward_context
description: Per-model forward context Map from layer name to layer objects that need to be accessed outside model code, e.g., Attention, FusedMOE when dp_size>1.

name: compilation.static_all_moe_layers
description: The names of all the MOE layers in the model

name: attention.backend
description: Attention backend to use. Use "auto" or None for automatic selection.

name: attention.minimax_m3_msa_decode_backend
description: Sparse decode kernel used by the MiniMax M3 MSA backend.

name: attention.backend_per_kind
description: Per-KV-cache-group attention backend overrides, keyed by `KVCacheSpecKind` (e.g. `{"mla_attention": "FLASHINFER_MLA", "sliding_window_mla": "TRITON_MLA"}`). This lets a model that splits its layers across multiple KV-cache groups (e.g.

name: attention.flash_attn_version
description: Force vllm to use a specific flash-attention version (2, 3, or 4). Only valid when using the flash-attention backend.

name: attention.flash_attn_max_num_splits_for_cuda_graph
description: Flash Attention max number splits for cuda graph decode.

name: attention.tq_max_kv_splits_for_cuda_graph
description: TurboQuant max NUM_KV_SPLITS for cuda graph decode. Fixes the split count so grid dimensions are constant across captures, and buffers can be pre-allocated to avoid inflating the memory estimate.

name: attention.use_trtllm_attention
description: If set to True/False, use or don't use the TRTLLM attention backend in flashinfer. If None, auto-detect the attention backend in flashinfer.

name: attention.disable_flashinfer_q_quantization
description: If set, when using fp8 kv, do not quantize Q to fp8.

name: attention.mla_prefill_backend
description: MLA prefill backend to use. If None, will be selected automatically. Valid options: FLASH_ATTN (FA3/FA4), FLASHINFER, TRTLLM_RAGGED.

name: attention.use_prefill_query_quantization
description: If set, quantize query for attention in prefill.

name: attention.indexer_kv_dtype
